decisions.reason: Product A builds on the firm's established offer, enabling the firm to interpret early results and learn, so management keeps it.
Product B is close to established knowledge and has shown field-test evidence, so the firm can assimilate and improve it further.
Product C builds on established components and the firm's own R&D, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it.
Product D builds on established flow-monitoring capabilities and has its own page, indicating the firm can assimilate and develop it.
Product E is close to the established offer and launched only in 2024, so the firm is still learning and likely to keep it.
